subject: Data erasure evidence & tenant-specific retention carveout — EuroClinic request
messages:
From: Dr. Lena Müller <lena.mueller@euroclinic.de>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@euroclinic.de, procurement@euroclinic.de
Date: 2026-11-24 08:12 CET
Subject: Request: tenant-specific erasure evidence for EuroClinic tenant (urgent)

Hi Naomi,

We're preparing for an upcoming regulatory inspection and need stronger assurances around deletion and retention for our Redwood tenant. Our standard contract references a 90-day debug-log retention window, but our legal team has asked for a documented proof-of-delete process for all session traces and ephemeral logs tied to our tenant for any data older than 30 days.

Specifically, can Redwood provide:
- A reproducible list of artifacts you will delete (by key/prefix) and the deletion timestamps;
- Signed evidence we can include in our audit packet (e.g., deletion report + attestation);
- Clarification on KMS key rotation/destruction vs object deletion (we need to understand whether key rotation fulfills our request or you perform object-level deletion as well);
- Whether Redwood will allow a time-limited escrow/third-party verifier to validate deletion within a defined window.

Because this will be part of a legal inspection, we need these deliverables within 48 hours if possible. I have looped in our security and procurement teams.

Thanks,
Lena Müller
Chief Privacy Officer
EuroClinic GmbH

Attachments: euroclinic_prelim_hold_and_scope.pdf (pdf)
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.example.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
Cc: lena.mueller@euroclinic.de, security@euroclinic.de
Date: 2026-11-24 09:05 CET
Subject: Fwd: Request: tenant-specific erasure evidence for EuroClinic tenant (urgent)

Ben / Jordan — forwarding EuroClinic's ask. They need a reproducible proof-of-delete package and an answer on KMS vs object deletion. They requested deliverables in 48 hours.

Initial thoughts: 1) We can produce an object deletion manifest from S3/GCS plus operation audit logs showing deletion API calls and timestamps. 2) For session traces in ephemeral hot storage (KV/redis caches) we need to outline the wipe sequence and retention TTLs; for older materials we should provide forensic export + verified deletion. 3) Ben — can we provide a signed attestation? Jordan — can you coordinate a short escrow/verification window (third-party) and logistics?

I'll prepare the evidence checklist and a proposed schedule. Please respond with feasibility and any missing asks.

Naomi
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proof_of_delete_checklist.pdf (draft)
From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.example.com, jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
Cc: lena.mueller@euroclinic.de
Date: 2026-11-24 11:18 CET
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: tenant-specific erasure evidence for EuroClinic tenant (urgent)

Naomi / Jordan —

We can meet EuroClinic's request within the 48-hour window with the following deliverables and constraints:

1) Deletion artifacts and manifest
- Provide a CSV manifest listing object paths/prefixes, object digests, and deletion timestamps (UTC). For tenant-scoped S3 blobs we'll attach lifecycle IDs and deletion job run-ids.
- Include server-side audit log entries (service account, delete API call, request_id).

2) Attestation and signed evidence
- We can produce a signed attestation (PDF) on Redwood letterhead describing the deletion actions and referencing the manifest. The attestation will be signed by me (Senior Security Engineer) and countersigned by our Legal Operations.

3) KMS vs object deletion
- Key rotation alone does not equate to cryptographic destruction for our standard platform; we treat object deletion as the primary action. We will document whether objects were re-encrypted, rotated, or fully zeroed according to backend capabilities. Where objects are stored on ephemeral instance volumes, we will document secure wipe procedures and provide the job logs.

4) Third-party verification / escrow
- We can allow a short, supervised verification window (2 business days) for a mutually agreed third-party auditor. That auditor must sign a non-disclosure and be scheduled with our Ops team during a maintenance window. We will not provide direct account keys for verification but can provide read-only signed manifests and deletion proofs.

5) For in-memory/kv-session traces
- We'll produce an explanation of TTL behavior, the exact timestamped eviction/delete events where available, and if necessary run a targeted flush/retention cutover and capture logs. Some in-memory traces are overwritten at scale and lack object-level IDs — we'll provide evidence of the eviction jobs and snapshot diffs.

6) Timeline / next steps
- Today (EOD CET): Finalize manifest generation and draft attestation.
- Tomorrow AM: Deliver signed attestation, manifest, and audit logs via secure share.
- Arrange auditor slot if EuroClinic confirms a verifier and preferred window.

Notes/limits: deletion evidence will reference internal request_ids and may contain operational metadata; we will redact customer PII where required. We also need a signed PO for escrow/audit charges if EuroClinic requests an on-site or dedicated auditor.

Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_deletion_manifest_template.csv (internal), ops_delete_run_20261124.log
From: Dr. Lena Müller <lena.mueller@euroclinic.de>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@euroclinic.de, security@euroclinic.de
Date: 2026-11-24 16:02 CET
Subject: Re: Request: tenant-specific erasure evidence for EuroClinic tenant (urgent)

Thanks Ben / Naomi — that scope looks close to what we need. A couple follow-ups from legal/security:

- We will provide the third-party auditor details by COB tomorrow; they are a GDPR-compliant firm and will sign NDAs.
- Our legal team prefers object-level deletion evidence rather than key-rotation-only approaches; please confirm that object manifests will not be redacted beyond operational request_ids. We understand redaction of customer PII is necessary, but we need the object identifiers used to reconcile with our logs.
- Regarding charges: procurement will send a signed PO for the audit window and any operational effort; I'll attach it to this thread.

Two technical clarifications:
1) For ephemeral cache traces, can you provide a short-lived snapshot export we can hash and reconcile pre/post-deletion?
2) For KMS-backed objects, please clarify whether you perform crypto-destruction (key unlinking + rekey + destroy) or just rekey/rotate. If destruction is possible, how do you evidence it?

Appreciate the quick turn.

Best,
Lena

Attachment: euroclinic_po_signed.pdf (pdf)
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.example.com
To: lena.mueller@euroclinic.de, ben_carter@redwood.example.com, jordan_blake@redwood.example.com, procurement@euroclinic.de
Date: 2026-11-25 15:27 CET
Subject: Re: Request: tenant-specific erasure evidence for EuroClinic tenant (urgent)

Lena / team —

Summary & action plan (next 48 hours):

1) Deliverables we will ship:
- Deletion manifest (CSV) with object keys/prefixes and UTC deletion timestamps.
- Ops deletion logs (request_ids + job ids) and snapshot diffs for ephemeral caches where object ids are available.
- Signed attestation PDF (Ben + Legal Ops).
- KMS treatment statement: we will provide per-bucket KMS metadata and indicate whether crypto-destruction was performed; where platform limitations prevent full crypto-destruction we will document compensating controls.

2) Auditor request:
- Please share the auditor contact and NDA by 09:00 CET tomorrow. We will provision a 2-business-day verification window and provide read-only signed manifests via the secure share link below. Auditor slot will be scheduled during our maintenance window on Nov 30–Dec 1 CET unless an earlier window is mutually agreed.

3) Logistics & proof delivery:
- Evidence will be uploaded to the secure share: https://redwood-share.company.com/evidence/euroclinic-20261124 (expiring link).
- DocuSign envelope for Ben/Legal attestation and the PO: https://docuSign.com/envelope/EUR-12345-DEL

4) Attachments included in this message: redwood_proof_of_delete_checklist.pdf, kms_key_rotation_diagram.png

Ben / Jordan — please proceed with manifest generation and legal countersignature. Ben, include the standard CAIQ/SIG mapping snippet that references where deletion proofs map to control objectives (e.g., CC6.1, CC7.4). Jordan, coordinate auditor slot and advise me once NDA is received.

Naomi
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
